notes:
Anivora 0.1.49 · Android version code 51

- Downloads now show compact episode cards with pause, resume, cancel and retry states. Episode details show live transfer size, speed, ETA and progress; Hide Process keeps the download running.
- Bounded provider recovery can reach sources beyond the first four, with cancellation, deduplication, health cooldowns and saved provider priorities. Added independent public adapters for 2dHive, AniKoto and KickassAnime, with strict title, episode and audio checks.
- All original 15 provider identities remain. YUKI, LOLI and SORA appear after Senshi as unverified source options; their actual Th3 upstream identities could not be established, so no endpoint or playback capability is invented.
- Verified metadata fallback uses explicit AniList/MAL/Kitsu mappings. Rich official AniList details are preferred when reachable on the device. Partial metadata and restricted sources are reported honestly.
- Improved on-demand episode/audio observations and provider health reporting without resolving entire catalogues. Quality labels reflect actual source information.
- Verified chapter lists and first-image bytes for Chainsaw Man, Jujutsu Kaisen and One Piece across WeebCentral, MangaKatana and MangaPill. Original black-and-white artwork remains unchanged. MangaKakalot is still upstream-restricted.
- Smooth sliding selections outside the player and complete My List closing transitions respect saved and system reduced motion. Player-specific screens and controls are unchanged.
- Complete update notes are retained, with the existing verified-APK reuse and installer workflow preserved.
- All legacy website browser pages redirect to their corresponding pages on anivora1.pages.dev, including admin, support, privacy, terms and title routes. Existing machine APIs and Android associations remain compatible.
- Admin bandwidth displays the percentage of the configured allowance used, clearly labels retained-metrics estimates, and reduces unnecessary polling. Provider observations cover all 18 source options.
- Production ads remain disabled pending Google approval. Existing signed, idempotent 10-point rewards and account data are preserved.

Install over your existing Anivora app; do not uninstall. The original package and signing certificate are preserved. Public-player URL resolution does not establish successful playback. Current physical Infinix/XOS, native installer and Cast receiver testing are unavailable in this environment; exact verification results and remaining provider restrictions accompany the release.
